transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we're reviewing the oral-history project proposal for the spring term before I give final approval. I'd like to hear from each of you on the current draft — specifically regarding student participation in grades 7 and 8, the one-adult-per-session supervision model, the cloud-based audio storage with a 90-day retention period, and the public exhibit of selected recordings. Let's start with any concerns or recommendations from your respective areas.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share some important findings from my classroom pilot. My end-of-pilot notes show that the project is instructionally ready only for grade 8 — not grade 7. Additionally, each interview session requires exactly two supervising adults, not one, because students are working with recording equipment alongside community guests. The current draft still reflects the original scope and staffing, so it needs to be updated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical discrepancy. The district privacy review, which I've completed, requires that all recordings remain on the district's encrypted internal server — not cloud-based storage. Additionally, recordings must be deleted exactly 45 days after the exhibit closes, not the 90-day retention period currently in the draft. Finally, signed guardian consent must be obtained before any student records an interview. The draft still uses the preliminary cloud-storage language and needs to be updated to reflect these privacy requirements before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the archive and rights review I completed. Each public exhibit audio excerpt is permitted to be no longer than exactly 3 minutes, and contributor attribution is required beside every excerpt. I've finished the rights check, but these limits have not yet been added to the exhibit template, so the draft needs to be updated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share findings from the family outreach review I completed. Consent materials must be available in exactly English, Spanish, and Arabic, and paper consent forms must be offered in addition to the online form. I've finished the outreach review, but the family-materials checklist has not yet been revised to reflect these requirements, so the draft needs to be updated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update the project draft to reflect grade 8 only participation and two supervising adults per session.
Update the draft to specify district encrypted internal server storage, 45-day post-exhibit deletion, and signed guardian consent before recording.
Add 3-minute maximum excerpt length and contributor attribution requirement to the exhibit template.
Revise the family-materials checklist to include consent materials in English, Spanish, and Arabic, with paper consent forms offered alongside the online form.
Final approval will be signed once all four updates are incorporated into the revised draft and resubmitted.
